title: 第1612章 丹增法王陨落第1611章 神祖对神祖
slug: 洪荒帝主第1616章韩家逼跪
content_zh:
李天站在数丈外，目光落在那道护甲上，没有开口。
但星辰剑在他手中微微抬起了一个角度，像是在寻找一个可以切入的时机。
丹增的左手再次结印，这一次他手中多了一串暗红色的佛珠，每一颗都有拇指大小，表面刻着细密的咒文，在月光下泛着暗沉的光泽。
佛珠在他掌中转动了一周，然后飞出，悬停在半空中，化作十八颗燃烧的暗红色光球，排列成一个卍字法阵，将雪瑶笼罩其中。
那些光球在法阵边缘持续地旋转着，每旋转一周，法阵的光亮便强一分，像是在用自己的方式把那段持续运转的规律嵌入正在合拢的空间中。
雪瑶没有急于突围，长剑在身前划出一道完整的圆，剑光化作一道冰蓝色的光环，与法阵的暗红色光芒形成对峙。
冰蓝与暗红在两股力量之间反复推进又后退，对抗着。
丹增再次出手，手中的白骨法杖在他掌中翻转，在暗红色法阵的光芒中泛起一层暗青色的光泽，朝法阵中心射去。
雪瑶没有后退，长剑横在身前，那团金色的光芒在她体内翻涌而出，沿着经脉蔓延到剑身上——玄冰金焰也是她第一次用。
金色的火焰裹着冰蓝色的剑光，迎向那道暗青色的光柱。
两股力量在空中相撞，没有爆炸，只有一声极轻的、玻璃碎裂的声音。
暗青色光柱从尖端开始凝固，金色火焰沿着光柱表面蔓延，像是一层正在覆盖的熔岩，在接触到光柱的瞬间将其从内部和外部同时包裹。
那道攻击在距离雪瑶三尺处彻底停住，然后化作碎片消散在空中。
丹增的面色终于彻底变了。
就在这时，雪瑶动了，长剑在金色火焰的包裹下，剑身周围凝结出一层细密的冰晶，温度骤降，空气中凝结出细碎的冰霜，在月光中泛着细碎的光。
她一步踏出，身形在夜色中化作一道冰蓝与金色交织的残影，朝丹增掠去。
丹增没有退，十八颗佛珠从法阵中收回，在他身前排列成一道盾牌，暗红色的光芒在佛珠表面流转，形成一道正在旋转的屏障。
长剑刺在屏障上，金色火焰与暗红佛珠接触的瞬间，发出一声刺耳的爆响。
佛珠表面开始出现细密的裂纹，暗红色的光芒正在以肉眼可见的速度暗淡。
丹增咬牙，左手再次结印，一道暗青色的掌印从掌心飞出，拍向雪瑶胸口。

雪瑶没有闪避，冰蓝长剑回撤，剑脊横在身前，挡住了那道掌印。
掌印落在剑身上，将她震退了三步，但没有伤到她。
丹增趁势后退，在数丈外站定。
此时他的袈裟已经碎裂多处，暗金色护甲表面有剑痕和烧灼的痕迹。
但他还没有放弃，右手摊开，一枚暗红色的玉印。
玉印脱手飞出的瞬间，化作一座丈许高的暗红色石碑，碑面上刻满密密麻麻的咒文，碑身散发出一股古老而沉重的气息。
石碑落地的瞬间，地面剧烈震颤。
一道暗红色的光芒从碑面涌出，化作一道光柱，直射雪瑶。
content_en:
Li Tian stood a few feet away, his eyes falling on the armor, but he didn't speak.
But the Star Sword was slightly raised at an angle in his hand, as if he was looking for an opportunity to cut in.
Tenzin's left hand formed a seal again, and this time there was a string of dark red beads in his hand. Each one was the size of a thumb, with fine incantations engraved on the surface, glowing darkly under the moonlight.
The beads rotated in his palm for a week, then flew out, hovered in mid-air, and turned into eighteen burning dark red light balls, arranged into a swastika formation, covering Xueyao.
Those light balls continued to rotate on the edge of the magic circle. Every time they rotated, the light of the magic circle became stronger, as if they were using their own way to embed the law of continuous operation into the closing space.
Xue Yao was not in a hurry to break out. The long sword drew a complete circle in front of her, and the sword light turned into an icy blue halo, forming a confrontation with the dark red light of the magic circle.
Ice Blue and Dark Red repeatedly advanced and retreated between the two forces, fighting against each other.
Tenzin took action again, and the bone staff in his hand flipped in his palm, glowing with a dark cyan luster in the light of the dark red magic circle, and shot toward the center of the magic circle.
Xueyao did not retreat. She held the long sword in front of her. The golden light surged out of her body and spread along the meridians to the sword - it was also the first time for her to use the Xuanbing Golden Flame.
Golden flames wrapped in ice-blue sword light faced the dark cyan light pillar.
The two forces collided in the air. There was no explosion, only a very light sound of glass breaking.
The dark cyan light pillar began to solidify from the tip, and the golden flame spread along the surface of the light pillar, like a layer of covering lava, wrapping it from the inside and outside at the same time as it came into contact with the light pillar.
The attack stopped completely three feet away from Xueyao, and then turned into fragments and dissipated in the air.
Tenzin's expression finally changed completely.
At this moment, Xue Yao moved. The long sword was wrapped in golden flames, and a layer of fine ice crystals condensed around the sword body. The temperature dropped sharply, and fine frost condensed in the air, glowing in the moonlight.
She took one step forward, and her figure turned into an afterimage of icy blue and gold in the night, rushing towards Tenzin.
Tenzin did not retreat. The eighteen beads were withdrawn from the magic circle and arranged into a shield in front of him. The dark red light circulated on the surface of the beads, forming a rotating barrier.
The long sword pierced the barrier, and the moment the golden flame came into contact with the dark red beads, there was a harsh explosion.
Fine cracks began to appear on the surface of the beads, and the dark red light was dimming at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Tenzin gritted his teeth and formed another seal with his left hand. A dark blue palm print flew out from his palm and hit Xueyao's chest.
Xue Yao did not dodge, and retreated with the ice blue sword, the sword spine lying in front of her, blocking the palm print.
The palm print fell on the sword, knocking her back three steps, but not hurting her.
Tenzin took advantage of the situation and retreated, standing a few feet away.
At this time, his cassock had been broken in many places, and there were sword marks and burn marks on the surface of the dark golden armor.
But he didn't give up yet. He spread out his right hand and revealed a dark red jade seal.
The moment the jade seal flew out of his hand, it turned into a dark red stone tablet about ten feet high. The surface of the tablet was covered with dense incantations, and the body of the tablet exuded an ancient and heavy aura.
The moment the stone tablet fell to the ground, the ground shook violently.
A dark red light emerged from the monument and turned into a beam of light, shining directly at Xueyao.
